data.long_meaning: The name Aleefa is derived from the Arabic word 'al-fa', which means 'soft' or 'gentle'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess delicate and graceful features, and who embody the qualities of kindness, compassion, and simplicity. The name Aleefa carries the meaning “Soft, Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aleefa usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
